title: Questions got an upgrade
summary: The questions page is your most visited page in Frigade's dashboard.
body_markdown:
The questions page is your most visited page in Frigade's dashboard.


You spend your time reviewing the your assistant's responses and this workflow is the core of why you feel confident that Frigade delivers the results you want.


We wanted to make that process easier to do over large sets of user questions, so we've redesigned the Questions page to make this process much simpler by allowing you to see your list of questions at a glance, while also viewing the Assistant's responses and user properties all in one screen.


You no longer have to flip back and forth or open and close a drawer and we think this new design brings a smoother workflow for reviewing, rating, and moving between questions.


Live now on the


[Questions page](https://app.frigade.com/questions) .
